description: Revision Kohn-Sham theory for dirac16complex in the author's primordial field (SPEC sections 1, 7), in the author's metric with b4(x4) in the extra-time components (b4 a function of x4, never 1): the exact reduction, functional, boundary conditions, rescaling identity, energy-momentum tensor, the history and the adiabaticity measure, i.e. the formulas the Rust solver Revision/kohn_sham/solver must implement. Every statement here is checked in Revision/kohn_sham/reports/ks-theory-wolfram.json and independently in ks-theory-python.json.
coordinates: the author's coordinates {x0, x1, ..., x7}: x0 = the hidden direction, z = 6 H x0 in (0, pi/2); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4} sin^{1/6} z); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the three exponentially DEFLATING extra times (scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} sin^{1/6} z; on the history e^{-a4/3} b4(0)^{1/2} sin^{1/6} z). Arrays index x0..x7 as 0..7 (xk at index k). Gamma matrices: Revision/algebra/gammas.json (gamma^(xk) = T16[k]).
units: H = 1 in the solver unless stated; energies, momenta and temperatures in units of m (or H); lambda has dimension mass^-6 (Psi has dimension 7/2 in 8 dimensions).

geometry.hiddenCoordinate: y = ln(sin z)/(6H) in (-inf, 0], sin z = e^{6Hy}, dy = cot z dx0; the patch end z = pi/2 is y = 0, the tip z -> 0 is y -> -inf
geometry.sqrtDetG: b4^{3/2} e^{6Hy} (= b4^{3/2} cos z in the author's chart x0..x7); independent of a4; the 7-volume changes as b4^{3/2}, on the history as b4(0)^{3/2} e^{2 a4}
geometry.kappa: kappa(y, x4) = e^{-Hy - a4(x4)} (the momentum weight; b4 does not enter)
geometry.spinConnection: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3H gamma^(x0) + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4) for every a4(x4), b4(x4): the a4' pieces of the 3 inflating directions (+(3/2) a4' gamma^(x4)) and of the 3 deflating directions (-(3/2) a4' gamma^(x4)) cancel, the b4' piece (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4) of the deflating directions remains

sectorAndAnsatz.sector: good sector: no dependence on x5, x6, x7 (extra-time momenta zero); coordinate 3-torus of size ell, k in (2 pi/ell) Z^3 = Delta k Z^3; extra-time coordinate volume v_t
sectorAndAnsatz.exactReduction: Psi = e^{i k.x} W^{-3} b4^{-3/4} chi(y, x4) gives EXACTLY (a4 and b4 time-dependent) g0 d_y chi + g4 d_x4 chi + i kappa k.gamma chi = (M_eff - i v_v g4) chi, i.e. i d_x4 chi = h(x4) chi with h Hermitian in int dy chi^dag chi = int sqrt|g| Psi^dag Psi over the hidden direction; the factor W^{-3} removes 3H gamma^(x0), the factor b4^{-3/4} (the half-density of b4^{3/2}) removes (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4); b4 does not appear in h
sectorAndAnsatz.instantaneousProblem: at a fixed instant x4 the instantaneous (adiabatic) Kohn-Sham problem is h(a4,0) chi = eps chi with a4,0 = a4(x4) (h does not contain b4; b4,0 = b4(x4) enters only the proper densities, see densities): the stationary-slice ansatz Psi = e^{-i eps x4} e^{i k.x} W^{-3} b4^{-3/4} V_beta chi(y)/sqrt(ell^3 v_t), normalised int_{-L}^{0} chi^dag chi dy = 1
sectorAndAnsatz.orbital16: Psi_16 = e^{-i eps x4} e^{i k x1} e^{-3Hy} b4^{-3/4} V[:, 2beta:2beta+2] chi(y)/sqrt(ell^3 v_t) for k = (k,0,0); other directions by the spinor rotation

blockBasis.construction: v+ = 8 P(j,s2,s3)(1+g0)/2 e_c (first column c with nonzero image), v- = g0 g1 v+; V = [v+ v- ...]/(2 sqrt 2), unitary
blockBasis.rowsAre: spinor components Psi_0..Psi_15; columns v+, v- of block 0, then block 1, ...

blockForms.Gamma: anticommutes with J, commutes with K1, K2: maps block (j,s2,s3) onto (-j,s2,s3), 2x2 entry s2 sigma2; on the reduced problem sigma2 h_j(M,k) sigma2 = h_{-j}(-M,k) and the brane parities are exchanged (chi2(0)=0 <-> chi1(0)=0)

blockEquation.hamiltonian: h_j = j[-i sigma1 d/dy + M_eff(y) sigma2 + kappa(y) k sigma3] + v_v(y), k signed along x1
blockEquation.ode: chi' = N chi, N = M_eff sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (eps - v_v) sigma1
blockEquation.realForm: chi = (a, i b), a, b real: a' = M_eff a - (kappa k + j(eps - v_v)) b, b' = (j(eps - v_v) - kappa k) a - M_eff b
blockEquation.realFormDensities: chi^dag chi = a^2 + b^2; chi^dag sigma2 chi = 2ab; chi^dag sigma3 chi = a^2 - b^2; chi^dag sigma1 chi = 0
blockEquation.typeRelation: h_{-1} - v = -(h_{+1} - v); sigma3 h_j(k) sigma3 = h_{-j}(-k): the (j,k) and (-j,-k) orbitals are degenerate with chi_{-j,-k} = sigma3 chi_{j,k}
blockEquation.degeneracy: for a lattice shell |k|^2 = Delta k^2 n2 with r3(n2) vectors: every level of h_j(|k|), j = +1 and j = -1 separately, is 4 r3(n2)-fold (4 blocks s2, s3 times the r3 directions); at k = 0 every level is 4-fold per j, 8-fold in total
blockEquation.rotation: spectra depend on |k| only (spinor rotation commutes with g0, g4, B, C)

exchange.interaction: U = (lambda/2) S^2, S = Psibar Psi = Psi^dag C Psi, normal ordered; lambda > 0 repulsive
exchange.expectationRule: <Psi^dag M Psi> = Tr(M rho), rho = sum_occ f u u^dagger B (SPEC section 6); quasi-free (Slater / Mermin) states
exchange.wick: <:S^2:> = (Tr C rho)^2 - Tr(C rho C rho)

uniformGas.result: any p -> -p symmetric occupation of the 8-fold good-sector gas (any temperature): rho = (n B + S C)/16; e_H = (lambda/2) S^2, e_x = -(lambda/32)(n^2 + S^2)
uniformGas.filledShellRatio: E_x/E_H = -1/8 for one filled level at rest (n = S)

kohnShamPotentials.e_int: e_int(n, S) = (15/32) lambda S^2 - (1/32) lambda n^2 (proper densities; in the solver's units lambda -> lambda_hat and every density times b4(0)^{3/2}, see densities.proper)
kohnShamPotentials.vv: v_v(y) = -lambda n(y)/16 (added to h as v_v times the identity)

exactFockSlab.result: for closed shells (k -> -k symmetric), equal occupation of the 4 blocks of each type and of the (j,k)/(-j,-k) partners, the EXACT Fock exchange of the Kohn-Sham determinant is local: e_x^exact = -(lambda/32)(n^2 + S^2 - Q^2 - Y^2), Q = <Psi^dag B gamma^(x0) Psi> = sum over orbitals of w g f q_o, q_o = e^{-6Hy} chi^dag sigma3 chi/(ell^3 v_t) for every orbital of either type (= j t_o; (a^2 - b^2) P in the real form), Y = y-current (0)
exactFockSlab.status: DIAGNOSTIC: the canonical functional is the uniform-gas one (SPEC section 7); the solver should report Delta E_x = +(lambda/32) int sqrt|g| Q^2 (the part the uniform-gas exchange omits). An exact-exchange variant would add w_Q = +lambda Q/16 sigma3 (both block types) to h and +(lambda/32) Q^2 to e_int.

densities.perOrbital: with P(y) = e^{-6Hy}/Vol_7, Vol_7 = ell^3 v_t (b4,0/b4(0))^{3/2} (= ell^3 v_t e^{(3/2) beta a4,0} on the history; the proper cell volume ell^3 v_t b4,0^{3/2} divided by b4(0)^{3/2}): n_o = P chi^dag chi, s_o = P chi^dag j sigma2 chi, t_o = P chi^dag j sigma3 chi (current along k-hat), q_o = P chi^dag sigma3 chi (= j t_o), c_o = P chi^dag j sigma1 chi = 0
densities.total: n(y) = sum_levels w g f n_o, S(y) = sum w g f s_o (same for t, q), g = 4 r3(n2), f the occupation, w = w_Z2 = 1/2: canonical convention = the doubled (universe + mirror image) system of the ASSUMED Z2 orbifold; its eigen-orbitals are the even- and odd-parity solutions, each normalised on the patch int_{-L}^{0} chi^dag chi dy = 1 (norm 2 on the doubled interval, hence w = 1/2 per patch); N = sum g f over both parities is the particle number of the doubled system (N/2 per copy)
densities.proper: the solver's densities are the proper densities (per proper 7-volume, P = e^{-6Hy}/(ell^3 v_t b4,0^{3/2})) times b4(0)^{3/2}, and its coupling is lambda_hat = lambda b4(0)^{-3/2}: lambda n_proper = lambda_hat n, and the proper cell volume times a proper density is Vol_7 times the solver's density, so every potential, energy, integral and level is the physical one and b4(0) never needs a value (check history_solver_units); coordinate densities are e^{6Hy} b4,0^{3/2} times the proper ones
densities.couplingVolumeScaling: a Kohn-Sham state depends on the coupling and the cell volume only through lambda/Vol (check ks_coupling_volume_scaling): the slice state at (lambda_hat, Vol_7(a4,0)) equals the state of the coordinate cell ell^3 v_t at lambda_eff = lambda_hat e^{-(3/2) beta a4,0} = lambda_hat e^{-2 a4,0} (beta = 4/3), whose densities are e^{2 a4,0} times the solver's (the form used by Revision/dark_sector/dirac16complex/compute/run_ks_history.py)

brane.statement: Z2 mirror (orbifold) at y = 0 under P_A: Psi(-y) = +-gamma^(x0) Psi(y) with the mirror warp W = e^{-H|y|}; continuity gives (1 -+ gamma^(x0)) chi(0) = 0: even parity chi2(0) = 0 (b(0) = 0), odd parity chi1(0) = 0 (a(0) = 0). P_A maps (M(y), v(y)) to (-M(-y), v(-y)): the doubled problem is P_A-symmetric iff M_eff is odd, i.e. the mirror copy carries (-m, +lambda) (S odd, n even). Both parities are the two P_A sectors of the doubled system and are solved and filled together. Both conditions kill the y-current.

tip.statement: at y = -L: (1 - Q(theta)) chi(-L) = 0, Q = cos(theta) sigma3 + sin(theta) sigma2; canonical theta = 0: chi2(-L) = 0 (b(-L) = 0). For k = 0 it admits the regular brane-localised zero mode (e^{My}, 0) for every L and no tip-localised mode for M > 0; for k != 0 an orbital is suppressed toward the tip like exp(-|k|(kappa(-L) - kappa(y))/H) so the levels do not depend on theta up to that factor.

boundaryConditions.selfAdjointness: phi^dag h chi - (h phi)^dag chi = d/dy[-i j phi^dag sigma1 chi]; with current-killing ends h_j is self-adjoint, levels real, orbitals orthogonal
boundaryConditions.exactK0Spectra: constant M > 0, v = 0, theta = 0: even: eps = 0 with chi = (e^{My}, 0), and eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/L)^2); odd: eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + p^2) with tan(pL) = -p/M

rescalingIdentity: a4,0 enters only through kappa k = e^{-Hy}(k e^{-a4,0}) and b4,0 only through the proper cell volume ell^3 v_t b4,0^{3/2}: KS(a4,0, b4,0; Delta k, v_t, lambda, N, T) = KS(0, b4(0); Delta k e^{-a4,0}, v_t e^{-3 a4,0} (b4,0/b4(0))^{3/2}, lambda, N, T) exactly (levels, orbitals, proper densities, EMT profiles). On the history b4 = b4(0) e^{beta a4} (beta = 4/3): KS(a4,0; Delta k, v_t) = KS(0; Delta k e^{-a4,0}, v_t e^{(3 beta/2 - 3) a4,0}) = KS(0; Delta k e^{-a4,0}, v_t e^{-a4,0}). The 3-momenta redshift as k e^{-a4}; the proper 7-volume of the cell grows as e^{(3/2) beta a4} = e^{2 a4}.

thermodynamics.fillingConvention: CONVENTION (not derived here; SPEC section 6 fixes particles as positive-frequency modes of the normal-ordered good sector): particles occupy the positive branch, i.e. the levels with eps > 0 of the lambda = 0 problem together with the k = 0 brane zero modes (eps = 0 at v = 0), each followed continuously as lambda is switched on; the negative branch is the normal-ordered sea and contributes nothing to N, n, S or T. The zero modes are self-conjugate at k = 0, v = 0 (spectrum of h_{+1} - v is minus that of h_{-1} - v); counting them as particle levels is the stated convention, its justification is OPEN.
thermodynamics.occupation: f = 1/(1 + exp((eps - mu)/T)), mu fixed by sum w_Z2 g f = N (Mermin)
thermodynamics.energy: E_KS (doubled system) = sum g f eps - 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} e_int dy, Vol_7 = ell^3 v_t e^{(3/2) beta a4,0} (densities.perOrbital); per copy one half of it
thermodynamics.grandPotential: Omega = -T sum g ln(1 + exp(-(eps - mu)/T)) - 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} e_int dy (doubled system); F = Omega + mu N

emt.definition: T^mu_nu = -<K^mu_nu> + delta^mu_nu <L>/sqrt|g>, K_mu nu = (1/4)[Psibar g_(mu D_nu) Psi - D_(nu Psibar g_mu) Psi] (symmetrised), <L>/sqrt|g| = e_int on shell; rho = -T^x4_x4, p_mu = T^mu_mu (SPEC section 4; homogeneous classical limit rho = mS + U, p = S U' - U)
emt.rho: rho(y) = sum w g f eps n_o - e_int
emt.p3: p3(y) = sum w g f (kappa |k|/3) t_o + e_int (shell-averaged; exact for every k -> -k closed cubic shell)
emt.p_t: p_t(y) = e_int (good sector: no extra-time kinetic pressure)
emt.p0: p0(y) = sum w g f [(eps - v_v) n_o - M_eff s_o - kappa |k| t_o] + e_int
emt.offDiagonal: T^x4_y = 0 for eigen-orbitals (K_x4y = P (eps - v/2) c_o, c_o = 0)
emt.trace: sum of the diagonal kinetic parts = M_eff S + v_v n per point
emt.conservationY: p0' + 6H p0 = 3H (p3 + p_t) for every self-consistent state (nabla_mu T^mu_y = 0): solver check
emt.energyChange: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d_x4 rho - 3 a4' (p3 - p_t) - (3/2)(b4'/b4)(rho + p_t); with sqrt|g| = b4^{3/2} e^{6Hy} on the history (b4'/b4 = beta a4'): dE/da4 = -3 (P3 - P_t) - (3/2) beta P_t, P = 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} p dy (beta = 4/3: -3 (P3 - P_t) - 2 P_t); Hellmann-Feynman with fixed occupations gives the same (solver check)
emt.integrated: 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} rho dy = E_KS; 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} 3 (p3 - e_int) dy = sum g f |k| d eps/d|k| (doubled system, w = 1/2 in the densities)

adiabaticity.history: a4 = A H x4 (A = 1 canonical), b4 = b4(0) e^{beta A H x4} (beta = 4/3), a4' = A H, b4'/b4 = beta A H; slices a4,0 = a4(x4), b4,0 = b4(0) e^{beta a4,0}; PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND (see historyStatus)
adiabaticity.historyBetaSource: SPEC section 1: with the author's Lovelock weights the mixed (x4, x0) equation of a source without a T^x4_x0 component allows on a4 = H x4 exactly d ln b4/d a4 in {0, 4/3}; b4 is not constant, so beta = 4/3 (Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json, exponentialHistory.authorWeights.branch)
adiabaticity.historyStatus: PRESCRIBED BACKGROUND: the history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^{(4/3) H x4} is prescribed, not solved for. With the author's Lovelock weights the a4 and b4 equations of SPEC section 5 allow it only with the constant source kappa (rho, p3, p_t, p0) = (-2/27, -2/9, -22/27, -14/27) (Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json, exponentialHistory.authorWeights.historySource); the Kohn-Sham states along it do not supply this source (they depend on x0 and change with a4,0: Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json). The Kohn-Sham gas is therefore a test field on a prescribed background without back-reaction, and quantities derived along this history (energies, pressures, equations of state) are not consequences of the coupled field equations.
adiabaticity.exactEvolution: i d_x4 chi = h(a4(x4)) chi (mean field); k, the block and the brane parity are conserved; transitions only between levels of the same (k, j, block, parity)
adiabaticity.derivative: d_a h_j = -j kappa k sigma3 (frozen potentials) + j (d_a M_eff) sigma2 + d_a v_v (self-consistent part, by finite differences between slices; it contains the change of the effective coupling lambda_hat/Vol_7(a4,0) ~ e^{-(3/2) beta a4,0})
adiabaticity.measure: Q_nm = A H |<n| d_a h |m>| / (eps_n - eps_m)^2 = A H |<n| d_a m>| / |eps_n - eps_m| for n occupied, m empty in the same sector; adiabatic iff max Q_nm << 1; leading-order transition probability ~ Q_nm^2
adiabaticity.hellmannFeynman: d eps_n/da = <n| d_a h |n> = -k d eps_n/dk (frozen)
adiabaticity.caveat: adiabatic evolution conserves the occupation of every (k, j, block, parity, level); when levels of different k cross the Fermi level between slices, the instantaneous aufbau ground state differs from the adiabatically continued state: the solver should flag such crossings. The non-adiabatic (time-dependent) problem is OPEN.

checksNumeric.braneBandSlopeFormula: c = e^{-a4,0} (2M/(2M-H)) (1 - e^{-(2M-H)L})/(1 - e^{-2ML}), d eps_0/dk = j c at k = 0 (even parity, theta = 0)

solverChecklist: free k = 0 spectra (even: 0, sqrt(M^2+(n pi/L)^2); odd: tan(pL) = -p/M)
brane-band slope c at small k
j-type mirror symmetry of the spectra (v = 0) and 4 r3(n2) degeneracy
exact rescaling identity between slices (a4,0 vs a4 = 0 with Delta k e^{-a4,0}, v_t e^{(3 beta/2 - 3) a4,0})
N conservation and the orbital normalisation
y-conservation p0' + 6H p0 = 3H(p3 + p_t) of every self-consistent state
trace identity and T^x4_y = 0 (zero y-current of every orbital)
dE/da4 = -3 (P3 - P_t) - (3/2) beta P_t, P = 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} p dy (doubled system), by finite differences between slices (fixed occupations)
exact-Fock diagnostic Delta E_x = (lambda/32) 2 Vol_7 int_{-L}^{0} e^{6Hy} Q^2 dy
